summary: Walmart reads are live-only (reject --data-source local before any request), print through the shared output path with meta.source live, and the doctor account probe is uncached and trusts only GraphQL account data without errors; cookie imports keep per-cookie scope and expiry across every file format, response cookies honor Max-Age (deletions are removed) and an existing but empty saved jar means logged out (the login-time cookie string is never re-seeded), and auth status reports the session and auth-cookie expiry without values; cart link accepts --items for MCP multi-item input, a harness-refused --open --json still returns the URL, and a cart read remembers the requested cart id.
reason: The generated paths assumed a local store, labelled fresh reads as local, treated any HTTP 200 as valid credentials, flattened cookie scope to .walmart.com, dropped Max-Age, and ignored expiry, so an expired or deleted Walmart auth cookie could look active and scripts could not trust source or output flags.
validated_outcome: Offline tests with fake values: TestLocalDataSourceRejectedBeforeNetwork, TestEmitReadAgentReportsLiveSource, TestClassifyAccountProbe, TestCookiesFile* (Playwright, extension array, Netscape, expired auth reads lapsed), TestSetCookiesPersistsMaxAgeAndDropsDeletions, TestEmptySavedJarDoesNotReseedLoginCookies, TestDescribeSavedSession, TestCartLinkHarnessJSONKeepsURL; MCP tools/call cart_link with items returned one 3-item link.
